description: This Java class, DefaultMonitoringConfig, provides access to monitoring configuration settings such as logger and counter configurations within a connectivity messaging service. It reads configuration data using the Typesafe Config library, encapsulates the configs, and overrides standard object methods for equality, hashing, and string representation.

classes.name: DefaultMonitoringConfig
classes.description: Immutable configuration class that provides access to monitoring-related settings such as logger and counter configurations for a messaging service connection.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of DefaultMonitoringConfig based on the provided Config object. Reads configuration data from a specified path ('monitoring').

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare DefaultMonitoringConfig instances based on logger and counter configurations.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides Object.hashCode for DefaultMonitoringConfig based on logger and counter configurations.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the DefaultMonitoringConfig instance.
